text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...! Yeah, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...! Hehe, what's wrong? Why such a 
serious look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
About the Japan Cup— I just can't 
understand it. Why me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Why, you ask...? Geez, that's so 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...―― I've run so many races to get to 
this point."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"So many high walls, so many battles 
against formidable foes. Of course, there 
were times she lost."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you know, the more I ran, the 
hotter the fire in my heart kept burning!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win, I want to win! Next time 
without fail! That feeling has always made 
my running stronger――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right now is surely my finest hour—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why right now— I want 
to race 'Curren Bouquetd'or'."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Watching the Takarazuka Kinen, you see, I 
just couldn't help but feel that way."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That day, beyond the screen, at the 
roaring Hanshin Racecourse—there you 
were."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...Ah. It's warm—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The sunflowers— I'm sure you were able to 
find them."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I never knew you could make a face like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The Bouquet-chan I know... is kinder than 
anyone, and that's why she struggles with 
competing."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, in the beginning, I was 
worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ""...... I want her to win...""

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...Bouquet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A competitive world where you have to kick 
others down must be a painful place for 
someone as kind as you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer was simply someone who always 
wanted me to run true to myself."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Because she truly believes that's what 
brings Umamusume happiness— she always 
puts Umamusume first."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want him to shine 
as he truly should. Just like with 
Ai-san... I want to gather the light upon 
him—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want her to shine 
as she truly should. Just like with 
Ai-san... I want to gather the light upon 
her—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had seized hold of my 
reason to win and started running.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just for his sake—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just for her sake—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And that is how she became so remarkably 
strong, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"For me, I win because I want to win. I 
win because I love winning."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: We're so close, yet so far apart.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The form of your strength... gives me 
such a thrill."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That is why, at the absolute peak of my 
strength, I want to—surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You were... thinking of such things for my 
sake, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: You are... a grand, blooming dahlia.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Always by my side, shining brighter than 
anyone else. Strong, beautiful—... and 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—If someone of your stature desires so 
deeply... for me to demonstrate my 
strength—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I will gratefully accept those feelings.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It's so thrilling...! Competing against 
you head-on like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well then, until next time. Let's meet at 
the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Takarazuka Kinen— I 
heard news about Almond Eye from Curren 
Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's sudden declaration of war 
took me by surprise, but it seems she had 
a very big reason of her own for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is an international G1 race 
held in the autumn. It's a grand stage 
where formidable rivals gather from both 
home and abroad.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—Would you please allow me to take on the 
challenge of the Japan Cup?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to Ai-san's feelings. 
...And besides..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"'Now I'm looking forward to the 
Takarazuka Kinen even more.' 'With the 
bond between you two, I hope you challenge 
Almond Eye someday.' —My, hehe."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I have seen voices expressing their wish 
for us to challenge Ai-san."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
... To me as well, Ai-san is... the exact 
opposite of who I am.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A competitor so formidable she could shift 
the era itself, driven solely by her 
desire to win. Powerful, fierce, and all 
the more beautiful for it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—If we can surpass her, carrying 
everyone's expectations along with us... 
then surely—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A whirlpool of pure jubilation erupts 
across the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The flower of victory will become a single 
golden bloom spoken of for generations to 
come—and with it, I believe our golden 
bouquet will at last be complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Now, there is no one in the racing world 
who doesn't know the name Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"For this Umamusume, even the Triple Crown 
is merely a stepping stone! It's Almond 
Eye!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who matched the legendary 7 
GⅠ victories established by the "Emperor" 
Symboli Rudolf. With every race, the 
weight of expectations grew heavier――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After achieving the Triple Tiara, she won 
4 GⅠ races without ever surrendering the 
position of first favorite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And taking on the unprecedented challenge 
of eight turf G1 wins, she is said to be 
the very symbol of a 'new era.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's a formidable opponent who has fought 
her way through countless races. She 
certainly won't be an easy one to beat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She understands that perfectly well. 
Which is precisely why—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Challenging Almond Eye right now holds 
immense significance."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
Win, and I want to show the world how 
brilliantly you shine

Win, and I want to show the world your 
radiance

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the crowd's expectations to 
overcome strong rivals— We should be able 
to bestow upon her the greatest glory of 
all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufuâyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we sat down and had a thorough 
discussion regarding her upcoming 
rotation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is in late November. I want 
to devote the summer to training, and then 
squeeze in one prep race after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of a race that seems fitting 
both in terms of timing and distance—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The All Comers... A 2200m turf G2 race 
held at Nakayama Racecourse, right."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember right, it's a course that 
tests stamina even more than its distance 
suggests... doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I feel we can weave a great result 
together. Please, let us do this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――In order to surpass Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to win the All Comers and 
carry that momentum into the final 
showdown!
